overview: Design education in India runs on three competitive pillars — NID DAT (Dec 21 2025 prelims for 2026 admissions; ~425 B.Des seats nationally), NIFT Entrance Exam (NIFTEE, Feb 8 2026; 18 NIFT campuses), and UCEED for IIT Bombay/Guwahati/Hyderabad/Delhi B.Des — supplemented by strong private/semi-govt routes (CEPT Ahmedabad, Srishti Bangalore, MIT-ID Pune, Pearl Academy, Symbiosis SID). The 2026 reality: UX/UI and product design dominate the high-pay end (₹15-50 LPA at MAANG India), while industrial, transportation, jewellery, and footwear design are severely undersupplied niches with strong abroad pathways. NID Ahmedabad B.Des total programme cost is around ₹19.29 lakh — high for a design degree, but placement medians at top studios (Microsoft, Google, Tata Elxsi, Mahindra Auto Design, Titan) make ROI strong. CEED is the entrance for M.Des at IITs — a strong B.Tech-to-design pivot.
key_insights: UX/UI design at MAANG India offers the highest design fresher salaries (₹15-30 LPA at Google/Microsoft/Adobe India) — outpacing most non-CS engineering roles.

Transportation/automotive design is severely undersupplied — Mahindra, Tata Motors, Maruti, M&M, Bajaj hire NID/Pforzheim grads at premium; foreign automotive houses (BMW DesignWorks, Pininfarina) recruit Indian talent.
Jewellery design (NIFT, GIA, JD Institute) is a high-margin self-employment-friendly path; Indian craftsmanship plus global certifications (GIA Graduate Gemologist) commands premium.

Animation and game design industry has stabilised post-2024; core demand from Mumbai-based studios (Reliance Entertainment, Toonz, Tata Elxsi), and AAA Indian studios (Studio Sirah, GameEon, Rovio Bangalore) is growing.
Footwear design (FDDI Noida, NIFT Accessory Design) is one of India's most under-applied design niches — Adidas/Nike/Bata India hire fresher footwear designers at ₹6-12 LPA.

sub_paths.name: Product Design (B.Des)
sub_paths.description: User-centered design of physical and digital products — ergonomics, materials, prototyping. Core NID/CEED specialty.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT (Prelims Dec 21 2025), UCEED 2026, CEED (PG), NIFT (limited product), MIT-ID DAT, Pearl Academy entrance
sub_paths.govt_fees: NID Ahmedabad/Bengaluru ~19 lakh total; IIT Bombay IDC B.Des ~10-13 lakh; UCEED IIT route similar
sub_paths.private_fees: MIT-ID Pune 16-22 lakh; Srishti Bangalore 16-25 lakh; Pearl Academy 12-18 lakh; Symbiosis Institute of Design 14-20 lakh
top_institutions: IIT Bombay IDC School of Design (govt)
Srishti Manipal Institute of Art Design Tech Bengaluru (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des at RCA London, Pratt NYC, Politecnico Milano, Delft TU, NUS Singapore. Direct industrial-design jobs at Apple, Google, Microsoft, Samsung Design hubs.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Sketching/CAD work (Rhino, Solidworks, Fusion 360), prototyping in studio, user research, design reviews. Mix of digital and physical making.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Lead → Design Director / Studio Owner. Mahindra, Tata Elxsi, Titan, Wipro Design, Microsoft Design hire heavily.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 6-15 LPA / Mid: 14-30 LPA / Senior: 30-80 LPA. Note: NID/IIT placements ₹10-20L median; private studios 5-10L; MAANG India product designer 15-30L. Source: NID/IIT placement reports.

sub_paths.name: UX / UI Design
sub_paths.description: User-experience and interface design for digital products — research, wireframes, visual design, prototyping. Highest-paying design specialty in India.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des UX/UI / B.A in Design / Self-taught + bootcamp portfolio
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT, UCEED, NIFT, ID&A entrance, bootcamp portfolio review
sub_paths.govt_fees: NID/IIT routes 10-19 lakh; CUET-supported BA Design ₹50K-2L
sub_paths.private_fees: Srishti/MIT-ID 16-25 lakh; Designboat Mumbai 1-3 lakh; Coursera Google UX cert ~₹3-5K
top_institutions: Internshala / Coursera / Google UX Cert (private MOOCs)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MS HCI at CMU, Georgia Tech, UW Seattle, KAIST. Direct UX jobs at Google, Apple, Meta abroad with India-trained portfolios.
sub_paths.day_in_life: User research, wireframing in Figma, prototyping, design reviews, dev handoff. Very screen-heavy; collaboration with PMs and engineers.
sub_paths.growth_path: UX Designer → Senior → Lead → Design Director / Head of Design. Strong founder track; UX-design consultancies (FoundingMinds, Lollypop) hire heavily.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 6-15 LPA / Mid: 15-35 LPA / Senior: 30-1 Cr+. Note: MAANG India UX 15-30L start; product startups 8-18L; design agencies 5-12L. Source: AmbitionBox, LinkedIn Salary.

sub_paths.name: Graphic / Communication Design
sub_paths.description: Visual identity, branding, print, digital communication design. Mainstream design career with broad employer base.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Communication Design / BFA Applied Arts / Diploma in Graphic Design
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT, NIFT, UCEED, Sir JJ entrance, university tests
sub_paths.govt_fees: NID 19 lakh; Sir JJ Mumbai ~50,000 total; College of Art Delhi 50K-1 lakh
sub_paths.private_fees: Pearl Academy/Srishti/MIT-ID 12-22 lakh; Whistling Woods 8-15 lakh
top_institutions: Sir J.J. Institute of Applied Art Mumbai (govt)
Whistling Woods School of Visual Communication Mumbai (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des / MA at RCA, Parsons, RISD, ArtCenter Pasadena, Konstfack Stockholm. Branding/agency hiring globally.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Logo/brand-identity work, layout design, print production, social-media/digital assets. Adobe Suite + Figma daily.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Art Director → Creative Director. Agencies (Ogilvy, Wieden+Kennedy India, Leo Burnett) and design studios (Codesign, Lopez Design, Elephant).
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3.5-8 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 18-50 LPA. Note: Top agencies 6-12L start; brand-design studios 5-10L; senior creative directors 25-60L. Source: AmbitionBox, agency disclosures.

sub_paths.name: Fashion Design (NIFT route)
sub_paths.description: Apparel design, textiles, fashion merchandising — primary route via NIFT 18-campus network.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Fashion / B.F.Tech Apparel / B.Des Knitwear
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NIFT Entrance Exam (NIFTEE, Feb 8 2026); CEED for PG; NID DAT (some)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA at Central Saint Martins London, Parsons NYC, Bunka Tokyo, Polimoda Florence, Marangoni Milan. Direct hiring at H&M, Zara, Adidas design teams.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Trend research, sketching collections, sourcing fabrics, sample fittings, fashion shows. Mix of studio and field work; fashion-week busy seasons.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Fashion Designer → Creative Director / Independent Label. Labels — FabIndia, Anita Dongre, Sabyasachi, Ritu Kumar — and brand-design teams at Myntra, Zara, H&M.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-8 LPA / Mid: 7-18 LPA / Senior: 18-50 LPA. Note: NIFT placement medians 5-9L; designer-label hiring 4-10L; corporate fashion (Myntra, Reliance Trends) 6-15L. Source: NIFT placement reports.

sub_paths.name: Interior Design
sub_paths.description: Residential, commercial, hospitality interior design — space planning, materials, lighting, furniture specification.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Interior / B.A. Interior Design / 1-2 yr Diploma
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT, NIFT, IIAD entrance, Pearl Academy, university tests
sub_paths.govt_fees: Sir JJ School of Art ~50,000 total; CEPT (semi-govt) 15-22 lakh
top_institutions: Sir J.J. School of Art Mumbai (govt)
Indian Institute of Art and Design Delhi (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des at Pratt, RISD, Politecnico Milano, RMIT Australia. Strong UAE/Singapore/UK hospitality-design hiring.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Site visits, AutoCAD/SketchUp/Revit work, mood boards, vendor coordination, client presentations. Mix of studio and on-site.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Design Lead → Studio Owner. Major studios (Studio Lotus, Hirsch Bedner, Rajesh Renganathan, RKHS) and hospitality firms (Taj, Oberoi, Marriott design teams).
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-8 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 18-50 LPA. Note: Top studios 5-10L start; self-employed studio founders highly variable; hospitality-design specialists 10-25L. Source: AmbitionBox, CEPT placement.

sub_paths.name: Animation & VFX
sub_paths.description: 2D/3D animation, character design, VFX compositing, motion graphics. Mumbai/Hyderabad studio sector growing.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 12th pass; demo reel + portfolio matters most
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Animation / B.Sc Animation & VFX / 1-2 yr Diploma
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT (Animation), NIFT, MIT-ID, FTII Pune entrance, institute tests
sub_paths.private_fees: Arena/MAAC/Picasso Animation 1-5 lakh; Whistling Woods/IIFA Bangalore 12-18 lakh
top_institutions: Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) Pune (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des/MA at CalArts, USC SCA, Sheridan Toronto, Gobelins Paris, Vancouver Film School. Pixar, DreamWorks, ILM hiring abroad.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Storyboarding, modeling, rigging, animation, lighting, comping. Long hours during render crunches. Studios run on production deadlines.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Animator → Senior → Lead → Director / Producer. Studios — Reliance Animation, Toonz Trivandrum, DNEG India, Tata Elxsi VFX, Studio Eeksaurus.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-7 LPA / Mid: 7-18 LPA / Senior: 18-60 LPA. Note: DNEG India / Technicolor 5-12L mid; Reliance Animation 4-10L; senior VFX supervisors 30-60L+. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Game Design
sub_paths.description: Game design, level design, narrative design, gameplay programming. Indian gaming industry growing post-Krafton/Tencent investments.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Game Design / B.Sc Game Design / 1-2 yr Diploma
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT (limited Game Design), NIFT, institute-specific tests
sub_paths.govt_fees: NID 19 lakh; IIIT-D Game Design 10-15 lakh
top_institutions: Backstage Pass Institute of Gaming Hyderabad (private)
MIT Institute of Design Pune - Game Design (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MS at USC Interactive Media, NYU Game Center, Carnegie Mellon ETC, Abertay UK (Dundee). AAA game-studio hiring abroad.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Game-mechanics prototyping, Unity/Unreal work, narrative design, playtesting, post-launch updates. Crunch periods around launches.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Game Designer → Senior → Lead → Game Director. Indian studios — Studio Sirah, GameEon, Rovio Bangalore, Krafton India, NodWin Gaming, ZeptoLab.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-10 LPA / Mid: 10-22 LPA / Senior: 22-60 LPA. Note: Indian indie studios 4-8L start; Krafton/Riot India type roles 12-25L; senior designers at established studios 25-50L. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Industrial Design
sub_paths.description: Mass-manufactured product design — appliances, consumer electronics, automotive components, medical devices.
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des at RCA, Pratt, ArtCenter Pasadena, Politecnico Milano, Delft, Umeå Sweden. Strong Apple/Dyson/IDEO hiring abroad.
sub_paths.day_in_life: CAD modelling (Rhino, Solidworks), prototyping, materials research, manufacturing handoff. Mix of studio and factory floor.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Design Lead → Studio Director. Tata Elxsi, Wipro Design, Onio (in-house at Eureka Forbes/Bajaj), Mahindra Auto Design, Titan.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 5-12 LPA / Mid: 12-25 LPA / Senior: 25-70 LPA. Note: Tata Elxsi 6-12L; Wipro Design 8-15L; senior at OEMs 25-50L. Source: NID/IIT placements, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Textile Design
sub_paths.description: Fabric and surface design — weave, print, knit. Strong link to Indian textile heritage industry.
sub_paths.private_fees: Pearl Academy 12-18 lakh; Symbiosis SID 14-20 lakh
top_institutions: Sir J.J. Institute of Applied Art (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA at Royal College of Art London, Chelsea, Politecnico Milano. Strong India craft-revival movement also brings UNESCO consultancy openings.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Loom/print studio work, surface-pattern design (Photoshop, dedicated tools), weaver/printer collaboration, mill visits.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Textile Designer → Senior → Studio Lead. FabIndia, Good Earth, Welspun, Raymond, ITC Mangaldeep, Anokhi top employers; craft-revival NGOs (Dastkari Haat) for those interested.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-7 LPA / Mid: 7-15 LPA / Senior: 15-35 LPA. Note: FabIndia/Good Earth 4-8L; Welspun corporate 6-12L; designer-label work variable. Source: AmbitionBox, NID/NIFT placements.

sub_paths.name: Jewellery Design
sub_paths.description: Fine jewellery and gemstone design — combining traditional Indian craftsmanship with contemporary techniques. Strong export industry.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Jewellery / Diploma in Jewellery Design + GIA Graduate Gemologist
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NIFT, IIGJ entrance, JD Institute, GIA institute test
sub_paths.govt_fees: NIFT Accessory Design 12-15 lakh; IIGJ Mumbai (semi-govt) 1-3 lakh
sub_paths.private_fees: GIA India Mumbai 5-15 lakh (incl. GG cert); Pearl Academy 12-18 lakh; JD Institute 4-10 lakh
top_institutions: Indian Institute of Gem & Jewellery (IIGJ) Mumbai (semi-govt, GJEPC)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA at Central Saint Martins London, RCA, FIT NYC, HRD Antwerp. Antwerp/Hong Kong/Tel Aviv jewellery trade major hubs.
sub_paths.day_in_life: CAD jewellery design (Matrix, Rhino), gem grading lab work, prototyping (3D printing, casting), bench work with karigars (artisans).
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Design Head → Independent Label / Atelier. Tanishq/Kalyan/Joyalukkas/PCJ/Nirav Modi-style designer ateliers, plus export houses.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-8 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior (designer-label): 15-50 LPA. Note: Tanishq/Kalyan 4-7L; export houses 5-12L; independent designer-jewellers earn variable but high-margin. Source: AmbitionBox, GJEPC.

sub_paths.name: Transportation / Automotive Design
sub_paths.description: Car, motorcycle, aircraft, EV vehicle design. Severely undersupplied niche; OEMs and design houses prize NID/Pforzheim grads.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT, UCEED, CEED, DSK Supinfocom entrance
sub_paths.private_fees: DSK Supinfocom Pune 18-25 lakh; ISDI Mumbai 18-25 lakh
top_institutions: DSK International School of Design (DSK ISD) Pune (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des at Pforzheim Germany, ArtCenter Pasadena, RCA, Politecnico Milano. Direct hiring at BMW DesignWorks, Pininfarina, Studio F.A. Porsche, Mercedes-Benz.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Sketching (Wacom/iPad), Alias modelling, clay modelling, design studio reviews. Long-cycle projects (3-5 yr concept-to-production).
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Studio Lead → Design Director / VP Design. Mahindra Auto Design (Mumbai/Pininfarina), Tata Motors Design (Pune/UK), Maruti Suzuki Design (Gurugram), Royal Enfield Design.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 6-15 LPA / Mid: 15-35 LPA / Senior: 35-1.5 Cr. Note: Mahindra/Tata/Maruti design 8-15L start; international design houses 25-60L; Studio F.A. Porsche India / BMW DesignWorks Mumbai pay premium. Source: NID placements, OEM disclosures.

sub_paths.name: Communication / Visual Design (M.Des / Editorial)
sub_paths.description: Editorial/publication design, motion design, information design. Distinct from generalist graphic design with stronger conceptual depth.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Communication Design / M.Des Visual Communication
top_institutions: Sir J.J. Institute of Applied Art (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des at RCA, RISD, Yale Graphic Design, Konstfack, Werkplaats Typografie Netherlands.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Editorial design for magazines/books, motion-design for screen, infographics, system design. Heavy collaboration with editors and content teams.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Visual Designer → Senior → Art Director → Creative Director. Editorial roles at Penguin India, HarperCollins, magazine editorial design, motion-graphics studios.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-9 LPA / Mid: 9-20 LPA / Senior: 20-50 LPA. Note: Editorial design at major publishers 5-10L; motion design at boutiques 6-15L; senior creative directors 25-50L. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Exhibition / Spatial / Retail Design
sub_paths.description: Trade show, museum exhibits, retail-store, brand-experience design. Combines architecture-adjacency with graphic + interactive.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Exhibition / M.Des Exhibition / Spatial Design
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT, UCEED, CEED, CEPT entrance
sub_paths.govt_fees: NID 19 lakh; CEPT 18-22 lakh; SPA Delhi 4-8 lakh
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des at RCA, Bartlett UCL, Pratt Spatial Design, ETH Zurich.
sub_paths.day_in_life: 3D modelling spaces, fabrication coordination, on-site installation. Strong project-based work; trade shows and museum projects.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Project Lead → Studio Director. Studios — Phenomena Design Mumbai, FRDC, Chrome Pictures, Reliance brand-experience teams.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3.5-8 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 18-45 LPA. Note: Trade-show/exhibition firms 4-8L start; museum/heritage exhibition higher; brand-experience studios 6-15L. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Ceramic / Glass Design
sub_paths.description: Functional and sculptural ceramics, glassware design — manufacturing, studio practice, craft-revival.
sub_paths.private_fees: Limited; mostly NID/IIT route. Pearl/Srishti electives 12-22 lakh
top_institutions: MS University Vadodara - Faculty of Fine Arts (govt)
Govt College of Fine Arts Chennai (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des/MA at RCA, Cranbrook USA, ENSCI Paris. Specialty crafts pathway via residencies (Skagaströnd Iceland, Hospitalfield Scotland).
sub_paths.day_in_life: Studio work — wheel throwing/handbuilding, kiln firing, glaze chemistry. Slow-paced craft/design hybrid; studio-practice founders run own kilns.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Studio Owner. Industry employers — Cera Sanitaryware, Orient Bell, Nitco; studio-practice route via Andretta, Auroville, Khurja.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-7 LPA / Mid: 7-15 LPA / Senior (studio owner): 8-25 LPA. Note: Ceramic studio work generally lower-pay than digital design; Cera/Orient industrial 4-8L; studio-practice income variable. Source: AmbitionBox, NID placements.

sub_paths.name: Leather Design (FDDI / NIFT)
sub_paths.description: Leather goods, footwear, accessories design — FDDI Noida is the central national institute. Niche with strong export pathway.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 12th pass; FDDI AIST or NIFT entrance
sub_paths.entrance_exam: FDDI AIST (All India Selection Test), NIFT Entrance
sub_paths.govt_fees: FDDI Noida (govt-aided) 5-10 lakh total; CLRI Chennai (govt) much lower
sub_paths.private_fees: Pearl Academy/JD Institute leather electives 10-18 lakh
top_institutions: Footwear Design and Development Institute (FDDI) Noida + 11 other campuses (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA at London College of Fashion, Polimoda Florence, Cordwainers London. Leather sector hubs: Italy, Spain, Vietnam.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Leather selection, pattern making, prototyping, manufacturing trial runs. Mix of studio and factory floor.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Design Head → Independent Brand. Bata, Adidas India, Reebok India, Hidesign, Tata-owned Westside hire heavily; export houses (Mirza International, Farida Group) major employers.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-7 LPA / Mid: 7-15 LPA / Senior: 15-35 LPA. Note: Bata/Adidas India 5-10L; Hidesign 4-8L; export-house designers 6-12L. Source: FDDI placements, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Accessory Design (NIFT)
sub_paths.description: Bags, belts, eyewear, watches, fashion accessories design. NIFT B.Des Accessory Design is the main route.
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA at Central Saint Martins London, Polimoda Florence, IED Milan. Direct hiring at Hermès, LVMH, Kering accessories teams.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Sketching collections, materials research, sample-making, factory liaison. Mix of design studio and visits to manufacturers.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Design Head → Brand Director. Hidesign, Titan Eye+, Fastrack, Hermes India, Allen Solly, Louis Phillipe.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-7 LPA / Mid: 7-15 LPA / Senior: 15-35 LPA. Note: Titan/Fastrack 4-8L; international brand offices 6-12L. Source: NIFT placements, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Furniture Design
sub_paths.description: Furniture and home-decor design — modular, contract, residential. Strong export industry, growing modular kitchen segment.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Furniture / M.Des Furniture & Interior Products
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NID DAT, UCEED, CEED, CEPT entrance
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: M.Des at RCA, Politecnico Milano, Domus Academy, Kingston London. Italian furniture industry (B&B Italia, Cassina) hires Indian designers.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Sketching, prototyping (often in shop), CMF (color/material/finish), client/factory presentations. Half-studio, half-workshop work.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Studio Lead → Independent Label. Godrej Interio, IKEA India, Featherlite, Fabindia Home, Pepperfry, Urban Ladder hire; designer-furniture brands (Phantom Hands, Studio Sequel) for craft route.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-8 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 18-40 LPA. Note: Godrej Interio/Urban Ladder 4-9L; designer-furniture studios 5-15L; senior at top studios 25-40L. Source: AmbitionBox, CEPT placements.

sub_paths.name: Footwear Design (FDDI)
sub_paths.description: Sport, formal, casual, fashion footwear design — FDDI Noida specializes. Strong export industry with Bata, Adidas, Nike Indian operations.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Des Footwear Design / B.F.Tech Footwear Tech
sub_paths.private_fees: Pearl Academy / JD Institute footwear electives 10-18 lakh
top_institutions: Footwear Design and Development Institute (FDDI) Noida + 11 campuses (govt)
Central Leather Research Institute (CLRI) Chennai (govt, R&D)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA at London College of Fashion (Cordwainers), Pensole Footwear Design Academy, Polimoda. Nike/Adidas/Puma global design teams hire Indian-trained designers.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Sketching, last-shaping, prototyping at shoe factories, materials sourcing. Heavy factory-floor time.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Designer → Senior → Lead Designer → Brand Design Head. Bata India, Adidas India, Nike India, Puma India, Hidesign hire fresher designers; export houses (Farida Group, Mirza Tannery) volume hiring.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3.5-7 LPA / Mid: 7-15 LPA / Senior: 15-30 LPA. Note: Bata 4-7L; Adidas India 6-12L; Nike India design 8-15L; export-house designers 4-9L. Source: FDDI placements, AmbitionBox.

data_confidence_notes: NID DAT 2026 cycle (prelims Dec 21 2025; mains result expected May 2026) verified via shiksha.com and NID admissions portal.
NID Ahmedabad B.Des total fees ₹19.29 lakh confirmed from collegedunia/NID 2026-27 fee structure.
NIFT Entrance Exam 2026 (Stage 1 Feb 8 2026) verified via NIFT/NTA notifications.
UX/UI/Product/Industrial Design salary bands align with NID/IIT placement reports for the last 3 years; MAANG India fresher offers verified via LinkedIn salary disclosures.

Niche fields (Ceramic/Glass, Leather, Accessory, Footwear, Exhibition, Furniture) flagged 'low/medium' confidence — Indian salary data is anecdotal and varies considerably; ranges should be treated as central tendency.
Game design industry data is volatile post-Krafton/Tencent investment cycles; figures based on 2024-25 disclosures and may shift with platform/regulatory changes.
